basis: Use maximum retained full and 52-entry screen wall times. Prior 0.01 scan required two full searches; budget the entire 100-step screen interval and all ten full bisection searches. Current AMP record has 5895 trials, matching the latest full-search timing.
limitations: A workload projection, not an upper bound. More than two full searches during the initial scan, a growing suspect set or trial record, and changing shared-machine pressure can increase the duration. No missing trace point is reconstructed.
